bullets.text: Q1 CR 86.4; personal lines CR 86.0; property CR 78.3; CL CR 89.0; net income $2B; strong start to 2026 after two years of exceptional results.
NPW +6% YOY; personal lines NPW +7% to $693M; CL NPW +3% YOY, driven by TNC growth; core commercial auto NPW flat due to business mix shifts.
Total PIFs +9% YOY; personal auto PIFs +11%; personal property PIFs +2%, driven by renters’ growth; 10% YOY increase in personal lines applications.
Personal auto model 9.0 expanded to 14 states (44% of TTM NPW); targeted rate decreases in profitable markets; CL model 8.3 launched in 16 states.
Personal lines vehicle non-acquisition expense ratio improved 0.4 pts YOY; continued focus on expense discipline and operational efficiency.
$1.5B raised via 5- and 10-year senior notes; $478M in share repurchases; debt-to-capital ratio remains below 30% threshold; portfolio return 0.1%.
Media spend +20% YOY; targeted agent incentives and advertising drove 10% YOY growth in personal lines applications; focus on efficient spend.
Personal auto model 9.0 and CL model 8.3 expanded; new CL product model development completed, with launch in first state planned for Q3 2026.
Commercial auto industry CR ~105 in 2025 (ex-Progressive); competitors raising rates; increased shopping activity in CL due to market adjustments.
Highlighted employee volunteer efforts during National Volunteer Month; stories of impactful community contributions reflect Progressive’s cultural values.
